test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All belts are wallets.

Some wallets are glasses.

Conclusions:

(I) Some belts are glasses.

(II) Some glasses are not wallets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

 
• All belts are wallets.
 
• Some wallets are glasses.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d09d805d6c594398edda2b745909c64e9eaa49f043c660c6c7bd1c9369d6a92.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f0ffb901323691bbdc8ba0c33817f097cfa5f1095e1f40acb9ec1bebe309c30.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some belts are glasses - **False** (There is no definite relationship between 'belts' and 'glasses'. So, the conclusion does not follow.)

II. Some glasses are not wallets - **False** (The statement "Some wallets are glasses" means there is an overlap. However, it is also possible that ALL glasses are wallets. Since this conclusion is not true in all possible scenarios, it does not logically follow.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
